id: AT-AP-17 (push readings of approvals, owner xxxxxxxx-10)
note: Owner xxxxxxxx-10 "Push names" (2026-10-26, confirmed "Keep all four"; NIGHT-REVIEW 3.4): all four push readings stay as built. P-1 plain words name gates (AT-AP-04 R3-02); P-2 a push approval that names no branch is protected-push, whatever branch is checked out; P-3 a local merge naming a protected branch is protected-push; P-4 a name after a remote prefix counts as that branch (team/release is release); the remote default branch (origin/dev) and a protected name (release) are gates. A named push of feat/x, a local merge into feat/x and team/feat-y carry, so the case is not one that asks for everything. Summary path (measure --compact --copy); the row counts the carried approvals by origin (owner xxxxxxxx-12). What names a branch for P-2 (review of the first build: any word with a slash used to count): a `branch <name>` target, a refspec of a git push (either side of src:dst) or a branch-shaped name right after "push" in plain words. A file-path target (U-10), a repo slug (U-11) and `git push origin HEAD` (U-12) name none and ask; plain "push feat/z" (U-13) and `HEAD:feat/q` (U-14) name one and carry.
